title: Assistant Manager - Human Resources
description:
**Additional Information**  
**Job Number**26128333  
**Job Category**Human Resources  
**Location**99 Residency Road, Bengaluru Karna 560 025, India  
**Schedule**Full Time  
**Located Remotely?**N  
**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

Assists in carrying out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she assists in delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Assisting in Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**

* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.

* Assists in establishing and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.

* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.

* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.

* Assists in monitoring candidate identification and selection process.

* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

**Assisting in Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**

* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.

* Assists with unemployment claim activity reports.

* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented, as needed.

**Assisting in Managing Employee Development**

* Assists with departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

* Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.

* Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.

* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs

* Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

**Assisting in Maintaining Employee Relations**

* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings).

* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.

* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner

* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi-Property Director of Human Resources.

* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.

* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

**Assisting in Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**

* Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.

* Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.

* Assists with ensuring medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.

* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).

* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.

* Assists with ensuring all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.

* Assists with periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.

* Assists with managing Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.

*At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.*

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.

Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.

The Business Development Manager is responsible for identifying, approaching, and onboarding new corporate accounts, travel partners, and B2B clients. This role blends sales strategy, client relationship management, and market research to grow the agency's booking portfolio and profitability.

· **Relationship Management:** Maintain long-term relationships with existing corporate clients to ensure high retention and repeat business.

· **Sales & Revenue Targets:** Design and execute strategic plans to meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

· **Proposal & Contract Negotiation:** Prepare commercial proposals, rate negotiations, and service-level agreements (SLAs).

· **Market Research & Competitor Analysis:** Monitor travel industry trends, competitor pricing, and corporate mobility demands to spot new growth opportunities.

· **CRM & Reporting:** Track leads, pipeline status, and grievances metrics using CRM tools, Google Sheets, or MS Excel.

title: Business Development Associate - India WFO
description:
**Job Title: Academic Counsellor**

**Position: Full Time**

**About Us**

At BrightCHAMPS, we’re committed to bridge the gap between traditional education and the skills kids need to thrive in a fast-changing world. Trusted by parents and students across 30+ countries, we deliver world-class learning experiences in technology, STEM, AI, financial literacy, communication, and more. With over 200,000 classes scheduled every month, we’re creating a global movement to equip children with the tools they need to lead successful, fulfilling lives with expert-designed courses tailored to each child’s age and grade.

**Role Overview**

The Academic Counsellor will connect with parents in the Indian market to understand their child’s learning needs and recommend the most suitable BrightChamps programs. The role focuses on consultative counselling, high‐quality conversations, and driving enrolments in a target‐oriented environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

Connect with Indian parents through inbound and outbound calls, WhatsApp, email, and video meetings to explain BrightChamps programs, curriculum, and learning outcomes.Understand the child’s current academic level, interests, and goals, and recommend the right courses and learning paths.Convert qualified leads into enrolments by handling objections, clarifying doubts, and clearly communicating the value and benefits of the programs. Maintain disciplined follow‐up and ensure all lead details, interactions, and status updates are accurately recorded in the CRM. Achieve weekly and monthly targets for revenue, conversion, and call‐handling productivity in a performance‐driven setup.Collaborate with Operations, Support, and Academic teams to ensure a smooth enrolment and bonboarding experience for Indian parents and students.

**Work schedule & Requirements**

Work days: 6 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday (weekday off as per business requirement).

Shift timing: 12:00 am to 10:00 PM IST (timings might change based on business need).

Mode: WFO

Laptop: Laptop & WiFi mandatory; candidates must have a personal laptop in good working condition and a stable broadband connection.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹450,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have your own Laptop ?
* Are you comfortable working 6 days a week with rotational week off ?
* Are you a immediate joiner ?
* Current CTC ?
* Expected CTC ?

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Systems Administrator, Billing Systems
description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
  
  
For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
  
  
Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.

**Title** : Sr Systems Administrator, Billing Systems

**Reporting to** : Sr Manager, Systems Engineering

**Location** : Bangalore, India

**Department** : Enterprise Business Systems

  
  

**Senior Systems Administrator, Billing Systems**

Billing infrastructure is revenue infrastructure. In a business running an enterprise sales-led motion and a product-led self-serve motion in parallel, the configuration quality of that stack directly determines what Finance can close cleanly, what customers are billed accurately, and how much revenue is recovered when payments fail. We're hiring a systems administrator who treats it that way.

The Senior Systems Administrator, Billing Systems is the senior platform expert across Quickbase's billing stack and a trusted operational partner to Finance, RevOps, and Product Engineering. This role owns day-to-day administration of and production support across the billing systems landscape in a scaled, dual-motion SaaS environment, currently anchored on BillingPlatform and Stripe, with the platform landscape expected to evolve. As the senior-most administrator on the team, this role also carries a higher bar for platform strategy, complex problem-solving, and mentorship of other billing systems administrators.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
--------------------

***Billing Systems Administration***

* Own multiple billing platform administration for both our product-led self-serve motion and sales-led enterprise grade invoicing and billing, including: payment methods, product and pricing catalog, subscription lifecycle, webhook monitoring, and dispute handling

* Maintain pricing configurations, billing templates, and subscription structures as directed by Finance and RevOps. When the price book changes, Billing Systems reflects it cleanly

* Own dunning and revenue recovery configuration: retry schedules, smart retry settings, grace period logic, and dunning email sequences. Monitor recovery rates and optimize the sequence over time

* Monitor platform health proactively. Identify processing failures, data integrity issues, and configuration gaps before they surface in Finance reporting or customer invoices

* Serve as the primary Stripe and enterprise billing platform contact for Finance, RevOps, and the billing engineering team

* Execute configuration changes following change management controls: documented, tested, and deployed cleanly

* Lead the evaluation, planning, and execution of billing platform changes and migrations, and serve as the escalation point and subject matter expert for the most complex billing systems issues

***Quote-to-Cash Integrations***

* Maintain the integration between Selling/Quoting systems and Billing Systems so quote-to-cash data flows are intact and deals land correctly in relevant billing systems

* Support CPQ-related billing configurations in partnership with the CPQ Lead: price book alignment, quote output formats, and contract-to-subscription linkages

* Configure and test PLG self-serve billing flows for new product launches, pricing changes, free trial conversion logic, and self-serve subscription management

* Proactively identify quote-to-cash risks and dependencies across billing, CPQ, and provisioning systems, and drive resolution ahead of launches and pricing changes

***Provisioning Connectivity***

* Partner with Product Engineering on the billing-to-provisioning handoff across both PLG self-serve and SLG enterprise motions

* Maintain the billing-side integration touchpoints that connect Stripe and our enterprise billing platform to provisioning workflows, ensuring subscription and order events carry the right data for downstream customer access

* Monitor the billing-to-provisioning handoff and escalate with context when subscription or order events fail to propagate cleanly into customer access

* Support provisioning impact assessment when pricing, packaging, or tier structures change on the billing side

* Lead root-cause analysis on recurring or high-impact billing-to-provisioning failures and drive the resulting process or configuration improvements to closure

***Data Quality & Reconciliation***

* Run regular data quality checks across billing systems: subscriber data, payment records, invoice history, and subscription states across SLG and PLG customers

* Support billing reconciliation across our enterprise billing platform, Stripe, Avalara, and NetSuite

* Support month-end and quarter-end close with clean, complete, defensible data for Finance reporting

* Maintain runbooks and escalation documentation for common billing data issues

* Mentor and provide technical guidance to other billing systems administrators, and contribute to team-wide best practices, standards, and documentation

**QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------

* 7+ years of experience in billing systems administration, revenue operations, or SaaS billing in environments serving both enterprise and self-serve customers, including experience operating as the senior-most or lead administrator on a billing systems team

* Deep hands-on experience with Stripe: subscription management, payment processing, webhook configuration, dunning configuration, and PLG billing flows

* Hands-on experience with an enterprise subscription billing platform (e.g., BillingPlatform, Revenue Cloud, Zuora, Chargebee) — depth on any one of these matters more than tenure on a specific platform

* Development skills in building automation workflows in billing systems via API, webhooks, and other workflow configurations

* Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ: quote-to-cash process, price book structure, and integration touchpoints with billing systems

* Familiarity with billing-to-provisioning integration patterns and partnership with product engineering teams on subscription event propagation

* Experience supporting billing reconciliation with Finance through NetSuite or equivalent ERP

* Experience in B2B SaaS environments with both sales-led and product-led revenue motions

* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional billing initiatives and mentoring less experienced administrators

***Preferred***

* Stripe certification such as Stripe Associate

* Experience with usage-based pricing models, including metered billing, freemium conversion, and monthly self-serve

* Experience owning or co-owning tax configuration and integration layer in a SaaS billing environment, including tax rule management, product taxability, and billing platform integration

* Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification or hands-on CPQ experience

* Experience evaluating or migrating between billing platforms a plus
  

  

**Important Notices**  
**Recorded Interviews.** Quickbase uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.
  
**Interview Integrity.** AI is part of how we work at Quickbase — we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.
  
**How We Review Applications** We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, schedule interviews, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

  
  
  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply – even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

  
  

**Benefits**

* Modern Health
* Group Medical Insurance
* Night Shift Allowance
* Hybrid Work Allowance
* Mobile and Internet Allowance
* Meal Benefit
* Office Transportation
* On-Call Weekend Allowance
* Weekend Working Allowance
* Employee Referral Bonus
